-- Settings are read when Play starts. Live panel changes last for this server session.
return {
	Enabled = true,
	Steps = 20,
	StudsPerStep = 3, -- A design convention, not the avatar's measured stride.
	StartRatio = 0.2, -- Fog starts at 12 studs and becomes opaque at 60 by default.
	Preset = "Night",
	Presets = {
		Field = Color3.fromRGB(177, 184, 158), -- muted green-grey for a daytime cornfield
		Dawn = Color3.fromRGB(205, 197, 171),
		Night = Color3.fromRGB(20, 27, 36), -- based on the current corn map's fog colour
	},
	MinSteps = 10,
	MaxSteps = 120,
	-- The panel is enabled in Studio. In published games add your numeric UserId here.
	AdminUserIds = {},
	AllowExperienceOwner = true, -- applies to an experience owned by a user, not a group
	PanelInStudio = true,
	-- Global fog is the reliable default. For field-only fog, set this true and
	-- set FieldCenter to the actual cornfield centre. Only the X/Z rectangle is used.
	FieldOnly = false,
	FieldCenter = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
	FieldSize = Vector3.new(840, 300, 840),
	EdgeFadeStuds = 30, -- blend inside the rectangle; not an invisible boundary wall
}

-- Drop the CornfieldFog model into Workspace or ServerScriptService.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local root = script.Parent
local config = require(root:WaitForChild("Config"))
local runtimeName = "CornfieldFogRuntime"
local previous = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(runtimeName)
if previous then
	local previousOwner = previous:FindFirstChild("Owner")
	if previousOwner and previousOwner:IsA("ObjectValue")
		and (not previousOwner.Value or not previousOwner.Value:IsDescendantOf(game)) then
		-- Studio Delete can unparent the model without firing Destroying.
		previous:Destroy()
		previous = nil
	end
end
if previous then
	warn("[CornfieldFog] A controller already exists. Keep only one CornfieldFog model.")
	return
end

local function finite(n)
	return type(n) == "number" and n == n and math.abs(n) < math.huge
end
local function number(n, fallback, low, high)
	if not finite(n) then n = fallback end
	return math.clamp(n, low, high)
end
local minSteps = number(config.MinSteps, 10, 1, 1000)
local maxSteps = number(config.MaxSteps, 120, minSteps, 1000)
local presets = config.Presets
local function canEdit(player)
	if config.PanelInStudio and RunService:IsStudio() then return true end
	if config.AllowExperienceOwner and game.CreatorType == Enum.CreatorType.User
		and player.UserId == game.CreatorId then return true end
	return table.find(config.AdminUserIds, player.UserId) ~= nil
end

local runtime = Instance.new("Folder")
runtime.Name = runtimeName
local remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
remote.Name = "Control"
remote.Parent = runtime
local owner = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
owner.Name = "Owner"
owner.Value = root
owner.Parent = runtime
local defaultPreset = presets[config.Preset] and config.Preset or "Field"
local defaults = {
	Enabled = config.Enabled ~= false,
	Steps = number(config.Steps, 20, minSteps, maxSteps),
	StudsPerStep = number(config.StudsPerStep, 3, 0.1, 100),
	StartRatio = number(config.StartRatio, 0.2, 0, 0.8),
	FogColor = presets[defaultPreset],
	Preset = defaultPreset,
	FieldOnly = config.FieldOnly == true,
	FieldCenter = config.FieldCenter,
	FieldSize = config.FieldSize,
	EdgeFadeStuds = number(config.EdgeFadeStuds, 30, 0, 420),
}
runtime:SetAttribute("MinSteps", minSteps)
runtime:SetAttribute("MaxSteps", maxSteps)
for key, value in defaults do runtime:SetAttribute(key, value) end
-- Publish a completely initialized state, so joining clients cannot read partial defaults.
runtime.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local connections = {}
local installed = {}
local installing = {}
local lastRequest = {}
local alive = true
local template = script:WaitForChild("ClientTemplate")

local function install(player)
	if installing[player] or installed[player] then return end
	installing[player] = true
	local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 20)
	if not alive or not playerGui or player.Parent ~= Players then
		installing[player] = nil
		return
	end
	player:SetAttribute("CornfieldFogCanEdit", canEdit(player))
	local bootstrap = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	bootstrap.Name = "CornfieldFogBootstrap"
	bootstrap.ResetOnSpawn = false
	local runtimeReference = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
	runtimeReference.Name = "Runtime"
	runtimeReference.Value = runtime
	runtimeReference.Parent = bootstrap
	bootstrap.Parent = playerGui
	local client = template:Clone()
	client.Name = "CornfieldFogClient"
	client.Enabled = true
	installed[player] = bootstrap
	installing[player] = nil
	client.Parent = bootstrap
end

connections[#connections + 1] = remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, request)
	if not canEdit(player) or type(request) ~= "table" then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (lastRequest[player] or -math.huge) < 0.08 then return end
	lastRequest[player] = now
	if request.Reset == true then
		for key, value in defaults do runtime:SetAttribute(key, value) end
		return
	end
	-- Only these small, validated fields may be changed by the control panel.
	if finite(request.Steps) then
		runtime:SetAttribute("Steps", math.floor(math.clamp(request.Steps, minSteps, maxSteps) * 10 + 0.5) / 10)
	end
	if finite(request.StartRatio) then
		runtime:SetAttribute("StartRatio", math.clamp(request.StartRatio, 0, 0.8))
	end
	if type(request.Enabled) == "boolean" then runtime:SetAttribute("Enabled", request.Enabled) end
	if type(request.Preset) == "string" and presets[request.Preset] then
		runtime:SetAttribute("Preset", request.Preset)
		runtime:SetAttribute("FogColor", presets[request.Preset])
	end
end)
connections[#connections + 1] = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player) task.spawn(install, player) end)
connections[#connections + 1] = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	installed[player] = nil
	installing[player] = nil
	lastRequest[player] = nil
end)
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do task.spawn(install, player) end

local function cleanup()
	if not alive then return end
	alive = false
	for _, connection in connections do connection:Disconnect() end
	-- Clients observe Destroying / removal and restore their original Lighting.
	runtime:Destroy()
	for player in installed do
		if player.Parent == Players then player:SetAttribute("CornfieldFogCanEdit", nil) end
	end
end
script.Destroying:Connect(cleanup)
root.Destroying:Connect(cleanup)
runtime.Destroying:Connect(cleanup)
connections[#connections + 1] = root.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
	if not root:IsDescendantOf(game) then cleanup() end
end)
connections[#connections + 1] = script.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
	if not script:IsDescendantOf(root) then cleanup() end
end)
connections[#connections + 1] = runtime.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
	if runtime.Parent ~= ReplicatedStorage then cleanup() end
end)

-- Portable client renderer and editor. Fog state is authoritative on the server.
-- This script does not change time of day, brightness, audio, or camera settings.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
if not player then return end
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local bootstrap = script.Parent
if not (bootstrap:IsA("ScreenGui") and bootstrap.Name == "CornfieldFogBootstrap") then bootstrap = nil end

-- Resolve the exact installation before acquiring ownership. ObjectValue targets may
-- arrive after the bootstrap itself, so an initial nil is not an uninstall signal.
local runtime = nil
local binding = bootstrap and (bootstrap:FindFirstChild("Runtime") or bootstrap:WaitForChild("Runtime", 10))
if bootstrap then
 if not binding or not binding:IsA("ObjectValue") then bootstrap:Destroy();return end
 local deadline = os.clock() + 10
 while not binding.Value and os.clock() < deadline and bootstrap:IsDescendantOf(playerGui) do task.wait(0.05) end
 runtime = binding.Value
else
 runtime = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("CornfieldFogRuntime")
 if not runtime then runtime = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("CornfieldFogRuntime", 10) end
end
if not runtime or not runtime:IsA("Folder") or not runtime:IsDescendantOf(ReplicatedStorage) then
 if bootstrap then bootstrap:Destroy() end
 return
end

local OWNER_NAME = "_CornfieldFogClientOwner"
local previousOwner = playerGui:FindFirstChild(OWNER_NAME)
if previousOwner and previousOwner:IsA("ObjectValue") then
 local other = previousOwner.Value
 if other and other ~= script and other:IsDescendantOf(playerGui) then
  local oldBinding = other.Parent and other.Parent:FindFirstChild("Runtime")
  local oldRuntime = oldBinding and oldBinding:IsA("ObjectValue") and oldBinding.Value
  if oldRuntime == runtime then return end
  -- Give the old controller a synchronous restore opportunity before taking a baseline.
  local stop = previousOwner:FindFirstChild("Stop")
  if stop and stop:IsA("BindableEvent") then stop:Fire() end
  local deadline = os.clock() + 2
  while previousOwner.Parent and os.clock() < deadline do task.wait() end
  if previousOwner.Parent then return end
 else previousOwner:Destroy() end
end
local owner = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
owner.Name = OWNER_NAME
owner.Value = script
owner.Parent = playerGui

local connections = {}
local uiConnections = {}
local dead = false
local fogOwned = false
local gui = nil
local controls = nil
local panelOpen = false
local drag = nil
local pendingMessage = nil
local pendingSerial = 0
local refreshUI
local heldAtmospheres = {}
local stash = Instance.new("Folder")
stash.Name = "_HeldAtmospheres"
stash.Parent = script
local original = { Color = Lighting.FogColor, Start = Lighting.FogStart, End = Lighting.FogEnd }

local function connect(bucket, signal, callback)
 local connection = signal:Connect(callback)
 table.insert(bucket, connection)
 return connection
end
local function disconnect(bucket)
 for _,connection in bucket do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
 table.clear(bucket)
end
local function restoreAtmospheres()
 -- Clear ownership before parenting, since this fires Lighting.DescendantAdded.
 for atmosphere,parent in heldAtmospheres do
  heldAtmospheres[atmosphere] = nil
  pcall(function()
   if atmosphere.Parent ~= stash then return end
   local target = Lighting
   if parent == Lighting or (parent and parent:IsDescendantOf(Lighting)) then target = parent end
   atmosphere.Parent = target
  end)
 end
end
local function restoreLighting()
 if fogOwned then
  pcall(function()
   Lighting.FogColor = original.Color
   Lighting.FogStart = original.Start
   Lighting.FogEnd = original.End
  end)
 end
 fogOwned = false
 restoreAtmospheres()
end
local function destroyUI()
 drag = nil
 controls = nil
 disconnect(uiConnections)
 if gui then gui:Destroy(); gui = nil end
end
local function cleanup()
 if dead then return end
 dead = true
 script:SetAttribute("CornfieldFogStopped", true)
 -- Restore synchronously while the script's stash still exists.
 restoreLighting()
 disconnect(connections)
 destroyUI()
 if owner.Parent and owner.Value == script then owner:Destroy() end
 pcall(function() stash:Destroy() end)
 if bootstrap then
  local oldBootstrap = bootstrap
  task.defer(function() pcall(function() oldBootstrap:Destroy() end) end)
 end
end
local stop = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
stop.Name = "Stop"
stop.Parent = owner
connect(connections, stop.Event, cleanup)
connect(connections, script.Destroying, cleanup)
connect(connections, script.AncestryChanged, function()
 if not script:IsDescendantOf(playerGui) then cleanup() end
end)
if bootstrap then connect(connections, bootstrap.Destroying, cleanup) end

if dead then return end
if not runtime or not runtime:IsA("Folder") or not runtime:IsDescendantOf(ReplicatedStorage) then cleanup(); return end
connect(connections, runtime.Destroying, cleanup)
connect(connections, runtime.AncestryChanged, function()
 if not runtime:IsDescendantOf(ReplicatedStorage) then cleanup() end
end)
local rootBinding = runtime:FindFirstChild("Owner")
if rootBinding and rootBinding:IsA("ObjectValue") then
 local watched = {}
 local function watchOwner()
  local root = rootBinding.Value
  if not root or watched[root] then return end -- nil is normal for ServerScriptService owners.
  watched[root] = true
  local wasInGame = root:IsDescendantOf(game)
  connect(connections, root.AncestryChanged, function()
   if root:IsDescendantOf(game) then wasInGame = true elseif wasInGame then cleanup() end
  end)
 end
 connect(connections, rootBinding:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"), watchOwner)
 watchOwner()
end

local function finite(value, fallback)
 if typeof(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value or value == math.huge or value == -math.huge then return fallback end
 return value
end
local function readState()
 local color = runtime:GetAttribute("FogColor")
 local center = runtime:GetAttribute("FieldCenter")
 local size = runtime:GetAttribute("FieldSize")
 local minimum = math.max(1, math.floor(finite(runtime:GetAttribute("MinSteps"), 10) + 0.5))
 local maximum = math.max(minimum, math.floor(finite(runtime:GetAttribute("MaxSteps"), 120) + 0.5))
 return {
  Enabled = runtime:GetAttribute("Enabled") ~= false,
  Steps = math.max(1, finite(runtime:GetAttribute("Steps"), 20)),
  MinSteps = minimum,
  MaxSteps = maximum,
  StudsPerStep = math.max(0.01, finite(runtime:GetAttribute("StudsPerStep"), 3)),
  StartRatio = math.clamp(finite(runtime:GetAttribute("StartRatio"), 0.2), 0, 0.8),
  FogColor = typeof(color) == "Color3" and color or Color3.fromRGB(20, 27, 36),
  Preset = runtime:GetAttribute("Preset") or "Night",
  FieldOnly = runtime:GetAttribute("FieldOnly") == true,
  FieldCenter = typeof(center) == "Vector3" and center or Vector3.zero,
  FieldSize = typeof(size) == "Vector3" and size or Vector3.new(840, 300, 840),
  EdgeFadeStuds = math.max(0, finite(runtime:GetAttribute("EdgeFadeStuds"), 30)),
 }
end
local state = readState()
local function canEdit() return player:GetAttribute("CornfieldFogCanEdit") == true end
local function send(patch)
 if dead or not canEdit() then return end
 local remote = runtime:FindFirstChild("Control")
 if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
  pendingMessage = "Нет связи с сервером"
  if refreshUI then refreshUI() end
  return
 end
 pendingMessage = "Применяется на сервере…"
 pendingSerial += 1
 local serial = pendingSerial
 local ok = pcall(function() remote:FireServer(patch) end)
 if not ok then pendingMessage = "Нет связи с сервером" end
 if refreshUI then refreshUI() end
 task.delay(2, function()
  if not dead and pendingSerial == serial then pendingMessage = nil;if refreshUI then refreshUI() end end
 end)
end

-- Region fading is horizontal only; Y and the cornfield's map size do not limit global fog.
local function regionWeight()
 if not state.FieldOnly then return 1 end
 local character = player.Character
 local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
 local position = root and root:IsA("BasePart") and root.Position or camera and camera.CFrame.Position
 if not position then return 0 end
 local dx = math.abs(position.X - state.FieldCenter.X)
 local dz = math.abs(position.Z - state.FieldCenter.Z)
 local margin = math.min(math.abs(state.FieldSize.X) * 0.5 - dx, math.abs(state.FieldSize.Z) * 0.5 - dz)
 if margin <= 0 then return 0 end
 if state.EdgeFadeStuds <= 0 then return 1 end
 return math.clamp(margin / state.EdgeFadeStuds, 0, 1)
end
local function holdAtmosphere(atmosphere)
 if dead or not fogOwned or not atmosphere:IsA("Atmosphere") then return end
 pcall(function()
  if atmosphere.Parent == stash then return end
  if not atmosphere:IsDescendantOf(Lighting) then return end
  if not heldAtmospheres[atmosphere] then heldAtmospheres[atmosphere] = atmosphere.Parent end
  atmosphere.Parent = stash
 end)
end
connect(connections, Lighting.DescendantAdded, holdAtmosphere)

local lastTarget = nil
local settledFor = 0
local current = nil
local function baseline()
 local distance = math.max(0.001, original.End)
 return { inverseEnd = 1 / distance, ratio = original.Start / distance, color = original.Color, active = false }
end
local function sameTarget(a, b)
 return a and a.active == b.active and math.abs(a.inverseEnd - b.inverseEnd) < 1e-9
  and math.abs(a.ratio - b.ratio) < 1e-6 and a.color == b.color
end
local function renderFog(deltaTime)
 if dead then return end
 -- Independent of the removed instance's signals, including deferred destruction.
 if not runtime:IsDescendantOf(ReplicatedStorage) then cleanup(); return end
 local weight = regionWeight()
 local wanted = state.Enabled and weight > 0.0001
 if wanted and not fogOwned then
  -- Capture fresh values on each activation, preserving changes made while this feature was off.
  original = { Color = Lighting.FogColor, Start = Lighting.FogStart, End = Lighting.FogEnd }
  current = baseline()
  fogOwned = true
  for _,obj in Lighting:GetDescendants() do if obj:IsA("Atmosphere") then holdAtmosphere(obj) end end
  lastTarget = nil
  settledFor = 0
 end
 if not fogOwned then return end
 local distance = math.max(0.01, state.Steps * state.StudsPerStep)
 local target = wanted and {
  inverseEnd = weight / distance,
  ratio = state.StartRatio,
  color = state.FogColor,
  active = true,
 } or baseline()
 local dt = math.clamp(deltaTime or 1 / 60, 0, 0.2)
 if sameTarget(lastTarget, target) then settledFor += dt else settledFor = 0 end
 lastTarget = target
 -- Unlike restarting a tween on each target change, exponential interpolation
 -- keeps progressing while the player moves continuously through the edge fade.
 local eased = settledFor >= 0.3 and 1 or (1 - math.exp(-dt / 0.09))
 local from, to = current, target
 current = {
  inverseEnd = from.inverseEnd + (to.inverseEnd - from.inverseEnd) * eased,
  ratio = from.ratio + (to.ratio - from.ratio) * eased,
  color = from.color:Lerp(to.color, eased), active = to.active,
 }
 if settledFor >= 0.3 and not wanted then
  restoreLighting()
  lastTarget = nil
  current = nil
  return
 end
 local fogEnd = math.min(100000, 1 / math.max(current.inverseEnd, 1e-8))
 Lighting.FogColor = current.color
 Lighting.FogEnd = fogEnd
 Lighting.FogStart = math.clamp(fogEnd * current.ratio, 0, fogEnd)
end
connect(connections, RunService.RenderStepped, renderFog)

local COLORS = { background = Color3.fromRGB(25, 30, 37), card = Color3.fromRGB(42, 49, 59),
 text = Color3.fromRGB(244, 247, 250), muted = Color3.fromRGB(174, 186, 199), accent = Color3.fromRGB(75, 154, 126) }
local function create(className, properties, parent)
 local object = Instance.new(className)
 for key,value in properties do object[key] = value end
 object.Parent = parent
 return object
end
local function rounded(object, radius)
 create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or 8) }, object)
end
local function text(parent, value, position, size, fontSize)
 return create("TextLabel", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = value, TextColor3 = COLORS.text,
  Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = fontSize or 16, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
  Position = position, Size = size }, parent)
end
local function button(parent, value, position, size)
 local object = create("TextButton", { BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.card, BorderSizePixel = 0,
  Text = value, TextColor3 = COLORS.text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextSize = 16,
  AutoButtonColor = true, Position = position, Size = size }, parent)
 rounded(object)
 return object
end
local function input(parent, position, size)
 local object = create("TextBox", { BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.card, BorderSizePixel = 0,
  Text = "", TextColor3 = COLORS.text, PlaceholderColor3 = COLORS.muted, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
  TextSize = 19, ClearTextOnFocus = false, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
  Position = position, Size = size }, parent)
 rounded(object)
 return object
end
local function parseNumber(value)
 return tonumber((value:gsub("%%", ""):gsub("%s", ""):gsub(",", ".")))
end
local function setPanel(open)
 panelOpen = open
 if controls then controls.panel.Visible = open end
end
local function buildUI()
 if dead or gui or not canEdit() then return end
 gui = create("ScreenGui", { Name = "CornfieldFogControls", ResetOnSpawn = false,
  IgnoreGuiInset = false, DisplayOrder = 80, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling }, playerGui)
 local screen = create("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1) }, gui)
 local opener = button(screen, UserInputService.TouchEnabled and "Туман" or "Туман · F6",
  UDim2.new(1, -154, 0, 14), UDim2.fromOffset(140, 46))
 local panel = create("Frame", { Name = "Panel", BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.background, BorderSizePixel = 0,
  AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 70),
  Size = UDim2.fromOffset(360, 500), Visible = panelOpen }, screen)
 rounded(panel, 12)
 text(panel, "Туман на карте", UDim2.fromOffset(16, 9), UDim2.new(1, -78, 0, 38), 21)
 local close = button(panel, "×", UDim2.new(1, -54, 0, 6), UDim2.fromOffset(44, 44))
 local body = create("ScrollingFrame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0,
  Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 56), Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, -66),
  CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
  ScrollBarThickness = 4, ScrollBarImageColor3 = COLORS.muted }, panel)
 create("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 10), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, body)
 local order = 0
 local function block(height)
  order += 1
  return create("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, height), LayoutOrder = order }, body)
 end
 local intro = block(32)
 local status = text(intro, "", UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), 14)
 status.TextColor3 = COLORS.muted
 status.TextWrapped = true
 local stepBlock = block(104)
 text(stepBlock, "Видимость, шаги", UDim2.new(), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24))
 local minus = button(stepBlock, "−5", UDim2.fromOffset(0, 32), UDim2.new(0.25, -5, 0, 48))
 local stepBox = input(stepBlock, UDim2.new(0.25, 5, 0, 32), UDim2.new(0.5, -10, 0, 48))
 local plus = button(stepBlock, "+5", UDim2.new(0.75, 5, 0, 32), UDim2.new(0.25, -5, 0, 48))
 local distanceText = text(stepBlock, "", UDim2.fromOffset(0, 84), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20), 13)
 distanceText.TextColor3 = COLORS.muted
 local sliderBlock = block(58)
 local sliderArea = button(sliderBlock, "", UDim2.new(), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40))
 sliderArea.BackgroundTransparency = 1
 local track = create("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.card, BorderSizePixel = 0,
  Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, -4), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 8) }, sliderArea)
 rounded(track, 4)
 local fill = create("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1) }, track)
 rounded(fill, 4)
 local thumb = create("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.text, BorderSizePixel = 0,
  AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22) }, track)
 rounded(thumb, 11)
 local minimum = text(sliderBlock, "", UDim2.fromOffset(0, 38), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 20), 13)
 minimum.TextColor3 = COLORS.muted
 local maximum = text(sliderBlock, "", UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 38), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 20), 13)
 maximum.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
 maximum.TextColor3 = COLORS.muted
 local ratioBlock = block(80)
 text(ratioBlock, "Чистая зона, %", UDim2.new(), UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 42))
 local ratioBox = input(ratioBlock, UDim2.new(1, -88, 0, 0), UDim2.fromOffset(88, 44))
 local startText = text(ratioBlock, "", UDim2.fromOffset(0, 48), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28), 13)
 startText.TextColor3 = COLORS.muted
 startText.TextWrapped = true
 local presetBlock = block(78)
 text(presetBlock, "Цвет тумана", UDim2.new(), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24))
 local presets = {}
 for i,preset in { {"Field", "Поле"}, {"Dawn", "Рассвет"}, {"Night", "Ночь"} } do
  local item = button(presetBlock, preset[2], UDim2.new((i - 1) / 3, i > 1 and 3 or 0, 0, 31), UDim2.new(1 / 3, -6, 0, 44))
  presets[preset[1]] = item
  connect(uiConnections, item.Activated, function() send({ Preset = preset[1] }) end)
 end
 local toggleBlock = block(48)
 local toggle = button(toggleBlock, "", UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromScale(1, 1))
 local resetBlock = block(44)
 local reset = button(resetBlock, "Сбросить настройки", UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromScale(1, 1))
 local footerBlock = block(38)
 local footer = text(footerBlock, "Изменения применяются ко всем игрокам.", UDim2.new(), UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), 12)
 footer.TextColor3 = COLORS.muted
 footer.TextWrapped = true
 controls = { panel = panel, status = status, stepBox = stepBox, ratioBox = ratioBox,
  distanceText = distanceText, startText = startText, fill = fill, thumb = thumb, presets = presets, toggle = toggle,
  minimum = minimum, maximum = maximum }
 local function resize()
  local size = screen.AbsoluteSize
  panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(220, math.min(360, size.X - 28)), math.max(180, math.min(540, size.Y - 84)))
 end
 connect(uiConnections, screen:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), resize)
 resize()
 connect(uiConnections, opener.Activated, function() setPanel(not panelOpen) end)
 connect(uiConnections, close.Activated, function() setPanel(false) end)
 connect(uiConnections, minus.Activated, function() send({ Steps = math.clamp(math.floor(state.Steps + 0.5) - 5, state.MinSteps, state.MaxSteps) }) end)
 connect(uiConnections, plus.Activated, function() send({ Steps = math.clamp(math.floor(state.Steps + 0.5) + 5, state.MinSteps, state.MaxSteps) }) end)
 connect(uiConnections, toggle.Activated, function() send({ Enabled = not state.Enabled }) end)
 connect(uiConnections, reset.Activated, function() send({ Reset = true }) end)
 connect(uiConnections, stepBox.FocusLost, function()
  local value = parseNumber(stepBox.Text)
  if value and value == value then
   value = math.clamp(math.floor(value + 0.5), state.MinSteps, state.MaxSteps)
   if value ~= state.Steps then send({ Steps = value }) end
  end
  refreshUI()
 end)
 connect(uiConnections, ratioBox.FocusLost, function()
  local value = parseNumber(ratioBox.Text)
  if value and value == value then
   value = math.clamp(value / 100, 0, 0.8)
   if math.abs(value - state.StartRatio) > 0.0001 then send({ StartRatio = value }) end
  end
  refreshUI()
 end)
 local function previewAt(x)
  if not drag or not controls then return end
  local fraction = math.clamp((x - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(1, track.AbsoluteSize.X), 0, 1)
  drag.steps = math.floor(state.MinSteps + fraction * (state.MaxSteps - state.MinSteps) + 0.5)
  refreshUI()
 end
 connect(uiConnections, sliderArea.InputBegan, function(inputObject)
  if drag then return end
  if inputObject.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and inputObject.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
  drag = { input = inputObject, touch = inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch, steps = state.Steps }
  previewAt(inputObject.Position.X)
 end)
 connect(uiConnections, UserInputService.InputChanged, function(inputObject)
  if not drag then return end
  if (drag.touch and inputObject == drag.input) or (not drag.touch and inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then previewAt(inputObject.Position.X) end
 end)
 connect(uiConnections, UserInputService.InputEnded, function(inputObject)
  if not drag then return end
  if inputObject == drag.input or (not drag.touch and inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
   local value = drag.steps
   drag = nil
   if value ~= state.Steps then send({ Steps = value }) end
   refreshUI()
  end
 end)
 refreshUI()
end

refreshUI = function()
 if not controls then return end
 local shownSteps = drag and drag.steps or state.Steps
 local fraction = math.clamp((shownSteps - state.MinSteps) / math.max(1, state.MaxSteps - state.MinSteps), 0, 1)
 controls.fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(fraction, 1)
 controls.thumb.Position = UDim2.fromScale(fraction, 0.5)
 if not controls.stepBox:IsFocused() then controls.stepBox.Text = tostring(math.floor(shownSteps + 0.5)) end
 if not controls.ratioBox:IsFocused() then controls.ratioBox.Text = string.format("%.0f", state.StartRatio * 100) end
 local distance = state.Steps * state.StudsPerStep
 controls.distanceText.Text = string.format("Сервер: %g шагов · %g студов", state.Steps, distance)
 controls.startText.Text = string.format("0–80%% · Начало тумана: %g студов", distance * state.StartRatio)
 controls.minimum.Text = tostring(state.MinSteps)
 controls.maximum.Text = tostring(state.MaxSteps)
 controls.status.Text = pendingMessage or (state.FieldOnly and "Область: поле. За границей туман отключён." or "Область: вся карта, без ограничения размером поля.")
 controls.toggle.Text = state.Enabled and "Туман: включён" or "Туман: выключен"
 controls.toggle.BackgroundColor3 = state.Enabled and COLORS.accent or COLORS.card
 for name,item in controls.presets do item.BackgroundColor3 = state.Preset == name and COLORS.accent or COLORS.card end
end
connect(connections, runtime.AttributeChanged, function()
 if dead then return end
 state = readState()
 pendingMessage = nil
 refreshUI()
end)
connect(connections, player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CornfieldFogCanEdit"), function()
 if canEdit() then buildUI() else destroyUI() end
end)
connect(connections, UserInputService.InputBegan, function(inputObject, processed)
 if processed or not canEdit() or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
 if inputObject.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F6 then setPanel(not panelOpen) end
end)
if canEdit() then buildUI() end

nodes.value: Insert CornfieldFog in Workspace or ServerScriptService and press Play. Open the Fog / Туман panel in Studio. Config holds persistent settings. Default: 20 design steps x 3 studs = 60 studs from camera; fog starts at 12. No external assets, no particles. Atmosphere is saved locally and restored. Live panel settings apply to this server session. See README_RU.md.
